params.name: file_format
params.description: File format name. See the [format guide](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/6111343326364) for all supported file formats.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit results to keys tagged with a list of comma separated tag names.

params.name: tag
params.description: Limit download to tagged keys. This parameter is deprecated. Please use the "tags" parameter instead

params.name: include_empty_translations
params.description: Indicates whether keys without translations should be included in the output as well.

params.name: exclude_empty_zero_forms
params.description: Indicates whether zero forms should be included when empty in pluralized keys.

params.name: include_translated_keys
params.description: Include translated keys in the locale file. Use in combination with include_empty_translations to obtain only untranslated keys.

params.name: keep_notranslate_tags
params.description: Indicates whether [NOTRANSLATE] tags should be kept.

params.name: convert_emoji
params.description: This option is obsolete. Projects that were created on or after Nov 29th 2019 or that did not contain emoji by then will not require this flag any longer since emoji are now supported natively.

params.name: format_options
params.description: Additional formatting and render options. See the [format guide](https://support.phrase.com/hc/en-us/sections/6111343326364) for a list of options available for each format. Specify format options like this: `...&format_options[foo]=bar`

params.name: encoding
params.description: Enforces a specific encoding on the file contents. Valid options are "UTF-8", "UTF-16" and "ISO-8859-1".

params.name: skip_unverified_translations
params.description: Indicates whether the locale file should skip all unverified translations. This parameter is deprecated and should be replaced with `include_unverified_translations`.

params.name: include_unverified_translations
params.description: if set to false unverified translations are excluded

params.name: use_last_reviewed_version
params.description: If set to true the last reviewed version of a translation is used. This is only available if the review workflow is enabled for the project.

params.name: fallback_locale_id
params.description:
If a key has no translation in the locale being downloaded, the translation in the fallback locale will be used.
Provide the ID of the locale that should be used as the fallback.
Requires `include_empty_translations` to be set to `true`. Mutually exclusive with `use_locale_fallback`.

params.name: use_locale_fallback
params.description:
If a key has no translation in the locale being downloaded, the translation in the fallback locale will be used.
Fallback locale is defined in [locale's settings](/en/api/strings/locales/update-a-locale#body-fallback-locale-id).
Requires `include_empty_translations` to be set to `true`. Mutually exclusive with `fallback_locale_id`.

params.name: source_locale_id
params.description: Provides the source language of a corresponding job as the source language of the generated locale file. This parameter will be ignored unless used in combination with a `tag` parameter indicating a specific job.

params.name: translation_key_prefix
params.description: Download all translation keys, and remove the specified prefix where possible. Warning: this may create duplicate key names if other keys share the same name after the prefix is removed.

params.name: filter_by_prefix
params.description: Only download translation keys containing the specified prefix, and remove the prefix from the generated file.

params.name: custom_metadata_filters
params.description: Custom metadata filters. Provide the name of the metadata field and the value to filter by. Only keys with matching metadata will be included in the download.

params.name: locale_ids
params.description: Locale IDs or locale names

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Only include translations and keys that have been updated since the given date. The date must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2023-01-01T00:00:00Z`).

items.docs: Download a locale in a specific file format.
